commit_message: Fix integrated Sequencer visual validation layout
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0126 Timeline / Sequencer first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Integrates the validated ADR 0126 foundation and canonical Animation, persistent Scene View Preview, Curve Editor, ReplayRequired, Audio, and VFX slices on current main. Resolves shared Timeline evaluation/control and Sequencer authoring ownership without rebuilding domain implementations.

Includes a visual-validation-only Sequencer sizing fix so the integrated Scene View preview evidence still exposes the Curve Editor key rows and graph at the validation viewport; production Sequencer sizing remains unchanged.

## Validation

Run exact-head Windows Validation for the affected scope and Editor Visual Validation for the integrated Sequencer/Scene View production preview path.
